identity.question: Will Russia and Ukraine hold any diplomatic meeting by November 30, 2026?

rule: Intentional official-capacity representatives authorized for Russia-Ukraine diplomacy; a designated mediator may qualify only with both governments' knowledge and authorization. Must be in person and publicly acknowledged by either government or credible-media consensus. Remote calls, chance greetings, and merely proposed talks do not qualify.

current_official_observations.facts: The President's Office says Zelensky had a phone call with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner and discussed the results of a meeting between Ukrainian and American teams in Florida. It says next diplomatic steps were being prepared, without naming Russian participants, an in-person Russia-Ukraine meeting, or a date for one.

current_official_observations.facts: Official photo captions say US envoys met Putin in Moscow on Sep 5 and travelled to Kyiv to meet Zelensky on Sep 6. These were separate US-Russia and US-Ukraine contacts, dated before Gamma creation; source does not describe a joint or mediated Russia-Ukraine meeting.
